variants.headline: Still in view: home-world ship reaches the colony
variants.sub: The colony has received the arrival of a home-world ship.
variants.body:
A ship from the home world has arrived in the colony. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

An arrival is a logistics fact, not a completed account of supply and demand. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
